name: @capgo/capacitor-in-app-review
description: Prompt users to submit app store ratings and reviews without leaving your app
author: Martin Donadieu <martin@capgo.app>

scripts.verify: bun run verify:ios && bun run verify:android && bun run verify:web
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check && npm run swiftlint -- lint
scripts.fmt: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write && npm run swiftlint -- --fix --format
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run docgen && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.example:build: bun run build && cd example-app && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.capgo:app:add: bunx @capgo/cli@latest app add app.capgo.in.app.review --name "Capgo In-App Review" --icon example-app/assets/capgo-icon.png
scripts.deploy:capgo:example: bun run example:build && cd example-app && bunx @capgo/cli@latest bundle upload app.capgo.in.app.review --path dist --channel production --package-json package.json,../package.json --node-modules node_modules,../node_modules --delta --no-key --ignore-checksum-check --version-exists-ok
